audit.why: Sejuani 55.24% over 105 games with the chart giving her Levels 1 through 6, Skill at his first item and Master Yi at two items. That matches the data and the scaling story; no change made.

audit.whatIsWrong: All four spikes were written without naming a single Master Yi ability — 'his kit', 'his on-hit shred', 'your stun and R'.
audit.why: Packet defect confirmed: the matchup never named Double Strike, Alpha Strike, Meditate, Wuju Style or Highlander. The spikes are exactly where the names belong, because each spike IS an ability coming online.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Alpha Strike, Meditate and Wuju Style and say what each does to Sejuani specifically.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent, and one active claim was wrong: 'a champion with no escape'.
audit.why: (1) Meditate is a channel — Riot's text confirms it, and Permafrost, Glacial Prison or the Arctic Assault knockup cancel it outright. That is the single highest-value line in this matchup and it was nowhere on the page. (2) Alpha Strike makes him UNTARGETABLE while it travels, so it eats a mistimed Permafrost or R — and it is his escape, which contradicts 'no escape'. (3) Highlander makes him 'immune to all slowing effects', so Winter's Wrath's slow and Glacial Prison's storm slow do nothing while it is up; the stuns still land, and Frost stacks still apply. (4) Wuju Style grants bonus TRUE damage on basic attacks, so Sejuani's armour stacking does not answer his DPS.
audit.corrected: All four now stated across spikes, whys, early, mid and late.

audit.why: Alpha Strike 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s and reduced by his basic attacks, Meditate a flat 10s, Wuju Style a flat 14s, Highlander a flat 85s.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike's 18-20s, Meditate's 10s and Highlander's 85s now appear in the text.
